---
title: "Explore building footprints"
format: html
---

Select a page from the dropdown to view its contents below.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// 1. Define your dropdown menu options
viewof selectedPage = Inputs.select(
  new Map([
    ["Google", "https://example.com"],
    ["Wikipedia", "https://example.com"],
    ["Local Report", "my_local_report.html"]
  ]), 
  {label: "Choose a page to display:", value: "https://example.com"}
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// 2. Dynamically update the iframe source based on the selection
html`<iframe src="${selectedPage}" width="100%" height="600px" style="border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px;"></iframe>`
```
